title: Shrimp Jones and the claim that Scott was never in his band
summary: Scott denies playing with Shrimp Jones or recording with Florence Mills's sister; Henderson was his first big band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: But before you joined Henderson, were you with Shrimp Jones at the Banville, or was that after --
No, Shrimp Jones, he was a good friend of mine. He had a band at Shuffle Along, which was a show with Florence Mills. And he went to Europe with that band and came back.
Yes, but weren't you in Shrimp's --
I wasn't in his band, no.
You were never in his band?
No, I wasn't in his band, no.
Did you ever record with Maud Mills, Florence's sister?
So the first band you were with, other than Honey's, was Fletcher's.
That was the big band, yeah. First big band, yeah. That was my first big band.
